name: Sentence with a photo strip
blueprint: A warm flat ground with no navigation bar. One sentence of four or five words runs as a single line of condensed capitals at clamp(96px, 7vw, 96px), sitting on the vertical centre and reaching edge to edge inside 28px margins. Where one word of the sentence would be, a strip of photograph takes its place: a frame exactly one cap-height tall (set in em) and 45–50% of the viewport wide, ratio near 5:1, corners radiused 14px, `object-fit: cover`. Build the line as a flex row with `align-items: baseline` and give the strip `flex: 1` so words and picture always fill the width. The photograph shows the thing the sentence names: a wide view of the place, taken from above or along a horizon, so it survives the letterbox crop. The top third of the screen is empty apart from a 15px wordmark top-left and two text links top-right. About 150px under the sentence the single action sits centred as a small solid button. One supporting sentence at 22px, max 44ch, is centred 48px above the bottom edge.
mobile: The sentence breaks into two lines at 21vw with the strip between them: the first words, then the photograph as a 2:1 frame at full width minus 16px margins with the same 14px corners, then the remaining words. The block is centred vertically. The action button sits 32px under the last line and the supporting sentence under that at 16px. The top links collapse to one word.
headline: A sentence of four or five short words, about 14 characters of type in total, whose missing word is the photograph.

name: Sentence split by a frame
blueprint: A white or pale ground. One short sentence is broken in two and pushed to the edges: the first half flush to the 32px left margin, the second half flush to the right margin, both on the vertical centre line at clamp(40px, 3.6vw, 60px), medium weight. Between them, dead centre on columns 5–8, sits one media frame: 35% of the viewport wide, 16:9, corners 4px, holding a photograph or a working fragment of the product. The frame belongs to a vertical reel: the bottom 60px of the previous frame shows at the top edge of the viewport and the top 60px of the next at the bottom edge, same width, 24px gaps, so the centre column reads as a strip passing through the sentence. The stage is sticky; the reel advances three or four steps while the two halves of the sentence hold their place. Wordmark top-left; three text links and the single action as a small solid button top-right, all at 15px. Bottom-left on columns 1–4: one supporting sentence at 18px, its last line 32px above the bottom edge. The other corners stay empty.
mobile: The halves stack: the first half of the sentence at 9vw flush left under the wordmark, then the frame at full width minus 16px margins and 4:3, then the second half flush right at 9vw. The neighbouring frames show as 28px slivers above and below. The supporting sentence and the action button follow at 16px. The links collapse to one word.
headline: One sentence of four to six words split into two halves of up to about 14 characters each; the frame between them shows what it is about.

name: Swatch column beside the view
blueprint: A 10px frame of paper colour surrounds the screen. Columns 1–10 are one photograph panel, full height inside the frame, corners radiused 12px, `object-fit: cover`: a wide, calm view with a low horizon and a great deal of sky. The headline is centred in the panel's upper third on two lines of light-weight serif at clamp(72px, 7vw, 96px), white, with a neutral scrim behind that band only if the sky is pale. The wordmark sits top-left inside the panel, 28px in. The single action, a white rectangular button, sits bottom-centre, 36px above the panel's lower edge; one supporting sentence at 18px sits bottom-left on columns 1–4, level with it. Columns 11–12 are both the navigation and a preview of the page: a full-height stack of five flat colour blocks of equal height, butted together with no gaps, each holding one text link at 16px in its top-left corner with 20px padding. The five colours are sampled from the photograph, ordered light to dark, and each is the ground colour of the section its link scrolls to. There is no other navigation.
mobile: The photograph panel takes the top 64svh inside an 8px frame, with the headline at 12vw on two lines in its upper third and the action button at its bottom-centre. The swatch column becomes five full-width bars, each 52px tall with its link at 15px, stacked directly under the panel; the first three show above the fold. The supporting sentence moves into the first section.
headline: A two-line statement of three to five words, up to about 14 characters per line at 8.6vw, set over the sky.

name: Striped card beside the room
blueprint: The viewport is split 50/50 with a 12px gap and 12px outer margins. The right half is one full-height photograph of the room, corners radiused 16px, `position: sticky` so it stays in view while the left half scrolls. The left half is a printed card: a flat paper-colour panel with the same 16px radius, and the subject's stripe (from its awning, label or ribbon) as the only ornament. Across the card's top runs a band 56px tall made of alternating bars of the single ink colour and paper, each bar 28px wide, built as a flex row of filled blocks. The same stripe returns as an 8px band above the footer and inside the button on hover. Under the band, centred: the wordmark about 300px wide, then a two-line headline in a light serif at clamp(40px, 3.6vw, 56px) in the ink colour, one supporting sentence at 17px held to 36ch, and the single action as a solid rectangular button. Three text links sit in one centred row at 15px, 28px above the card's bottom edge. One ink on paper; the photograph supplies every other colour.
mobile: The photograph comes first at full width inside 12px margins, 48svh tall, with the 16px radius. The card follows and overlaps the photograph's bottom edge by 24px using a negative margin. Its striped band is 40px tall; below it the wordmark at 56% width, the headline at 8vw on two lines, the sentence and the button, all centred. The links wrap into the card's foot.
headline: A warm two-line welcome of three to six words, up to about 18 characters per line at 3.6vw.

name: Giant cropped shape
blueprint: A plain ground with one flat shape at enormous scale. The shape is the simplest geometry found in the subject (a circle, a ring segment, a chamfered block, an arch), drawn in CSS or as a single inline SVG path and filled with the accent colour. It is about 120vh across and enters from the right, centred near 78% of the width and 55% of the height, so the top, right and bottom edges of the viewport crop it and its left boundary reaches column 7. If the subject has a true pair (two accounts, two modes), a second shape in a second flat colour overlaps the first by a quarter with `mix-blend-mode: multiply`. The headline sits on the bare ground on columns 1–6, vertically centred, flush left at 8% from the left edge: two lines at clamp(64px, 6.4vw, 96px), heavy weight, tracking -0.03em. Beneath it comes one supporting sentence at 19px, then the single action as a solid button cut to the same shape. A bold wordmark sits top-left at 32px; up to three text links sit top-right in the ground colour.
mobile: The shape moves to the bottom: 130vw across, centred horizontally, its top at 56svh, cropped by the left, right and bottom edges. The headline sits above it at 11.5vw on two lines at a 16px margin, starting 15% down, with the sentence at 16px and the motif-shaped button beneath. Wordmark top-left; the links collapse to one word top-right.
headline: Two lines of two or three words each, up to about 12 characters per line at 6.4vw.

name: Fragment on a shaped stage
blueprint: A neutral ground. The headline occupies the upper-left third: two lines at clamp(52px, 5.2vw, 80px), medium weight, flush left on columns 1–6 at a 40px margin, starting 150px down. One supporting sentence at 18px, max 40ch, follows, then the single action as a small rectangular button. The rest of the screen belongs to one flat stage in a saturated colour: it spans columns 5–12, begins 42% down, and bleeds off the right and bottom edges. Its top-left corner is cut with the product's own shape using `clip-path` (a notch, a chamfer or a tab two columns wide), the only decoration on the page. On the stage, 56px in from its left and top edges, sits the main fragment of the interface at true size with labels at 13–15px, built in HTML and working: one panel or control about 620px wide, cropped by the bottom edge, never a whole window and never inside a browser or laptop frame. Mark its root with data-ui. Navigation is a plain row at 28px from the top: wordmark left and four text links right at 15px. Nothing overlaps the headline.
mobile: The headline sits under the wordmark at 10vw on two lines, followed by the sentence at 16px and the button. The stage comes next at full width, bleeding off both sides and the bottom, its corner cut kept at 72px wide. The fragment sits 16px inside it at true size; if it is wider than the screen the right edge crops it rather than scaling it down.
headline: A plain statement of what the product does in three to six words, two lines of up to about 16 characters each at 5.2vw.

name: Control that reads the page
blueprint: A near-black or deep neutral ground split into two halves by tone alone: the right half is one step lighter than the left, and they meet at a clean vertical edge at 50%. Left half: a small logo mark top-left at a 40px margin, then two-thirds of empty ground, then everything else anchored bottom-left, 40px from the edges: a one-line headline at clamp(26px, 2.1vw, 32px) in medium weight, one supporting sentence at 17px in the softer ink held to 44ch, and the single action as a light rectangular button. Right half: one fragment of the product, centred, about 450px square, built in HTML and working. It is the product's defining control (a loupe, a picker, a dial, a field) and it acts on the page itself: it reads the real background colour, the real headline size or the pointer position and prints that value in its own readout at 13px. Mark its root with data-ui so the product's own radii and borders apply inside it. There is no navigation bar; one text link sits top-right at 15px.
mobile: The halves stack as two tones. The fragment comes first: 78vw square, centred in the lighter block, which is 58svh tall, still live and reading the page under the visitor's finger. The darker block below holds the headline at 6.4vw on up to two lines, the sentence at 16px and the button, left-aligned at 20px. The logo mark sits top-left over the first block.
headline: One plain line at 26–32px naming what the tool is, up to about 32 characters, wrapping to two lines on a phone.

name: Controls on the sentence
blueprint: A dark flat ground with no logo bar: a 14px wordmark top-left and the single action as an underlined text link top-right, both 28px in. The headline is a two-line sentence, centred, at clamp(96px, 7vw, 96px), line-height 1.0, occupying the middle 64% of the width and sitting slightly above the midline. It is set in a variable font and it is the demonstration. Three small control chips from the product sit on top of the sentence, each about 300 by 80px with the product's true radius, a text label and a numeric readout: one above the first line near its left end, one overlapping the start of the second line, and a two-state switch at the lower right. They are tilted 2 to 4 degrees and filled solid, one step lighter than the ground. Each one works: dragging the first changes the headline's weight through `font-variation-settings`, the second changes its letter-spacing, the third toggles uppercase. Mark each chip's root with data-ui. One supporting sentence at 17px, max 40ch, is centred 72px under the headline. The bottom third of the screen stays empty.
mobile: The sentence stays on two lines at 13.5vw, centred at 38% of the height. The three chips shrink to 200 by 60px and move off the letters: one above the sentence and two side by side beneath it, untilted and still live. The supporting sentence follows at 16px. The wordmark stays top-left and the action link top-right.
headline: A two-line sentence of three to five words, up to about 11 characters per line at 9vw, that still reads when its weight and spacing change.

name: Column on one line
blueprint: A warm off-white page that is more than 80% empty. Everything hangs on one vertical alignment 27% in from the left edge, the start of column 4; nothing is centred and nothing sits to its left. A small logo mark sits on that alignment 56px from the top. About 220px lower the column begins, only 380px wide: a two-line headline at 27px in medium weight, line-height 1.25; one supporting sentence at 15px in the softer ink, line-height 1.5; then, 28px below, the single action as a near-black rectangular button with 4px corners and one text link with an arrow beside it. A sign-in text link sits alone in the top-right corner at 14px; there is no navigation bar. At the bottom edge the first demonstration peeks in on the same alignment: a flat panel one step darker than the page, 368px wide, its top 90px visible, holding two real rows of the product's interface at true size with a visible pointer. Mark the panel's root with data-ui. The right half of the screen is blank on purpose, and nothing spans the full width until the footer.
mobile: The alignment becomes the 24px left margin. The logo mark sits 32px from the top and the column starts at 30% of the height: headline at 24px on two lines, the sentence at 15px, then button and text link side by side. The demonstration panel spans the width between the margins and shows its top 120px above the fold. The sign-in link stays top-right.
headline: A dry two-line statement at 27px, up to about 30 characters per line; it never grows larger at any width.

name: Object splits the headline
blueprint: One deep, flat ground colour. The object, a low-key studio photograph whose background matches the ground, stands at dead centre, scaled to 66% of the viewport height and tilted about 8 degrees, with its base cropped by the bottom edge. The headline is split around it: line one is centred across the object's upper fifth and line two across its lower fifth, both at clamp(64px, 5.8vw, 92px), regular weight, spanning columns 2–11, so the object fills the gap where a paragraph would normally sit. The type lies above the object in the stacking order in the light ink, so every letter stays readable where it crosses. At the object's mid-height two small text blocks at 14px face each other: the supporting sentence far left on columns 1–2, and two short facts (size, price) far right on columns 11–12, right-aligned, each 32px from its edge. Wordmark top-left; three text links top-centre; the single action top-right as a small light rectangular tab, the only light solid on the screen. The lower corners stay dark and empty.
mobile: The object is 54svh tall, centred, its base cropped by the bottom edge. Line one of the headline crosses its top at 11vw and line two its lower third at 11vw, both centred inside 16px margins. The side text blocks merge into one 15px sentence under the navigation. Wordmark top-left and the action tab top-right; the links collapse to one word.
headline: A two-line statement of four to six words, up to about 16 characters per line at 5.8vw, with the object standing between the lines.

name: Object on the seam
blueprint: A white or very pale page organised by one change of tone. A square-cornered panel one step darker than the page (a flat pale blue-grey or warm grey) fills the top 44% of the viewport inside 12px margins; the page colour runs below it. The object, photographed on a plain background and blended with `mix-blend-mode: multiply`, straddles the seam between the two tones: it is about 62% of the viewport wide, starts at column 6 and runs off the right edge, with its upper half over the panel and its lower half over the page. Type is small and exact. The headline is two lines at 24px in medium weight, far left on columns 1–3 at a 32px margin, its first baseline resting exactly on the seam; the second line is set in the softer ink. One supporting sentence at 15px, max 34ch, sits 120px lower on the same margin with the single action as a small rectangular button under it. A plain top row inside the panel at 14px: wordmark left, three text links centred, one text link right.
mobile: The tonal panel takes the top 46svh. The object is 120vw wide, centred on the seam and cropped by the right edge. The headline sits just under the seam at 22px on two lines at a 20px margin, with the sentence at 15px beneath and then the button. The wordmark sits top-left inside the panel; the links collapse to one word top-right.
headline: Two short sentences at 24px, one per line and up to about 28 characters each, the second in the softer ink.

name: Statement beside specimen mosaic
blueprint: The viewport is split 50/50 by tone alone: the left half is the page ground, the right half a field one step darker, meeting at a clean vertical edge with no line. Left half: the wordmark at 22px sits top-left on a 32px margin; under it the statement at clamp(44px, 4.4vw, 68px), bold, tracking -0.04em, leading 1.0, top-left aligned and filling the upper 40% of the half. The lower part of this side stays empty except for one supporting sentence at 18px pinned bottom-left and the single action as a solid rectangle beside it. Right half: a loose mosaic of seven specimen tiles on a 4-column, 3-row grid with 14px gaps. Each tile is a flat palette colour at 3:4 holding one cut-out item, centred, object-fit: contain, mix-blend-mode: multiply. Five cells are left empty so the tiles stagger; one tile spans two columns and two rows; the rightmost column is cropped by the viewport edge. Two text links sit top-right over the darker field. The right half may be position: sticky while the left scrolls.
mobile: The split becomes a stack. The statement comes first at 10.5vw on two lines inside 20px margins, the supporting sentence under it at 16px, then the action. Below, the darker field runs full width and the mosaic becomes two columns of tiles, the right column started 48px lower than the left; five tiles show and the last row is cropped by the bottom of the screen. Navigation is the wordmark and one link.
headline: A 3-5 word statement of what is on offer, at most 28 characters so it holds two lines at 10.5vw on a phone.

name: Single specimen with name list
blueprint: Borrowed from a museum plinth. A calm light ground with roughly 70% left empty. The wordmark is set large for a logo, about 28% of the viewport wide (clamp(64px, 6vw, 92px), heavy serif or grotesk), top-left on a 56px margin; one sentence of description at 15px sits top-right on the same margin, its first line aligned to the top of the wordmark. Dead centre stands one specimen: a flat tile in a palette colour, 400px wide and 460px tall (columns 5-8) with a 16px radius, holding a single cut-out item at about 80% of the tile height, object-fit: contain. Left of the tile, in columns 2-4, a vertical list of item names is right-aligned towards it: the selected name in full ink at 20px, the names above and below stepping down in size and opacity (18, 16, 14px; 60, 35, 15%). Choosing a name swaps the item and the tile colour. Below the tile, centred: the item's one-line fact at 14px, then the single action, a filled rectangle 240px wide. Three text links sit bottom-left at 14px.
mobile: The wordmark sits top-left at 11vw with the description sentence beneath it at 15px. The tile takes the full width inside 20px margins at 4:5, starting at 30% of the height. The name list becomes one horizontal row under the tile that scrolls sideways with scroll-snap, the selected name centred in full ink at 18px. The action sits full width at the bottom of the screen; the links move to the footer.
headline: The name itself as an oversized wordmark, up to 10 characters on one line; there is no separate statement.

name: Counter object, wide wordmark
blueprint: Borrowed from a watch or perfume counter. One flat charcoal field. Centred slightly above the midline, a single low-key photograph of the object about 31% of the viewport wide (columns 5-8), 4:5, its own dark background matched to the field with filter: brightness(0.9) so it sits without a frame. Under it the name runs on one line as an ultra-wide wordmark spanning 72% of the width yet only about 45px tall: an extended face with letter-spacing near 0.6em, or a regular face stretched with transform: scaleX(2.4). Then one centred serif sentence at clamp(24px, 2.6vw, 38px). Then a single centred row at 15px with 48px between its three parts: one specification, the price inside the one solid light rectangle that is also the action, a second specification. The wordmark repeats small top-left and one text link sits top-right, both on 32px margins. The bottom fifth and both outer quarters of the screen stay empty and dark.
mobile: The photograph grows to 70% of the width at 4:5, its top at 16% of the height. The wide wordmark spans the full width inside 20px margins at about 28px tall. The serif sentence sets at 6vw on two lines. The row stacks into three centred lines with the action in the middle at full width. The lowest sixth of the screen stays dark and empty.
headline: The name as a very wide, very low wordmark on one line (up to 12 characters); the serif sentence beneath is the supporting line, up to 40 characters.

name: Text band, then sheet
blueprint: A black or white field on a seven-column grid with 14px margins and 14px gaps. There is no display type: everything is set at one size, 16px, in one weight. The top band is plain text hanging from a line 20px below the top edge: the name in column one; one sentence on availability in column two; a list of five or six services from column three; a longer list of clients or awards from column five; and two links, profile and the single contact action, at the right end of column seven. Lists run one item per line. Below the lists about 300px of ground is left empty. At mid-height the sheet begins: one thumbnail per column, each the full column width (about 190px) at its natural ratio, top-aligned, with the project title in the text size above the first frame of each run of two to four frames. Rows continue below the fold with 40px between them. Frames have square corners and sit directly on the ground with no border and no caption on the image.
mobile: The grid becomes two columns with 12px gaps. The name and the availability sentence take the top; services and clients sit side by side under them as two short lists at 15px. An 80px gap follows, then the sheet: two frames per row at natural ratios, each project title above its first frame. The contact action is a text link fixed bottom-right.
headline: None at display size: the name is set at 16px with the rest of the text, and one sentence of up to 60 characters says what the person does.

name: Sheet with a text cell
blueprint: The whole viewport is a sheet of photographs: six columns with 12px gaps and 12px outer margins, each column a vertical stack of frames at natural ratios with square corners. Each column starts at a different vertical offset (0, -90, -40, -130, -20, -70px) so rows never line up and the top and bottom frames are cropped by the viewport. Every frame has a flat strip 28px tall fused to its bottom edge in a solid palette colour, carrying one line of 13px text (a title or a place); strip colours rotate through four values. There is no header. In columns 3-4, starting at 28% of the height, one cell of the sheet is not a photograph but a filled panel in the tone opposite to the ground, 410px tall, sitting on the grid like any other frame with the same gaps on all sides. Inside it, top-left aligned on 24px padding: the wordmark at 28px, one sentence at 20px on up to three lines, the single action as a filled rectangle, and three text links on one line at the panel's foot.
mobile: The text panel spans the full width as the first block, about 40% of the screen height, with the wordmark at 7vw, the sentence at 17px and the action full width. Under it the sheet resumes in two columns with 8px gaps, the right column started 60px higher than the left, colour strips kept on every frame. The links sit in one row at the panel's foot.
headline: The wordmark at 28px plus one sentence of up to 70 characters inside the panel; nothing is set at display size.

name: Lit strip, four corners
blueprint: One near-black field with a single lit band. Four small pieces of text at 14px, medium weight, sit in the corners on 72px side margins and 44px top and bottom margins: the name top-left, one link top-right, one sentence saying what this is bottom-left (max 36ch), the single action as a text link bottom-right. Across the vertical middle runs one horizontal strip of photographs, 34vh tall (about 300px), each at its natural width with 10px gaps and square corners: eleven or more frames in a flex row wider than the viewport, so the first and last visible frames are cropped by the left and right edges. The frame nearest the centre is at full brightness; the others sit at filter: brightness(0.55) and brighten on hover or as they reach the centre. Under the centred frame, aligned to its left edge, its title is set in the same 14px text. The top quarter and the bottom quarter of the screen stay empty and dark. The strip scrolls sideways with overflow-x: auto and scroll-snap; never hijack vertical scroll.
mobile: The strip stays a single sideways-scrolling row but grows to 46vh tall, so one frame and the cropped edges of its neighbours fill the width. The name and the link sit at the top on 20px margins; the sentence and the action stack bottom-left under the strip at 14px. Dark space remains above and below the strip, about 12% of the height each.
headline: None at display size: the name at 14px in a corner and one sentence of up to 60 characters.

name: Mosaic masthead, title on axis
blueprint: The top 52% of the viewport is a full-width masthead band built as a gutterless mosaic: a CSS grid of 6 columns and 2 rows in which four cells are photographs (object-fit: cover, all greyscale via filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.05)) and the rest are flat tiles in two or three palette colours. One photograph spans two columns and one colour tile spans both rows; cells butt together with no gap. The header lies flush on the band's upper edge: the wordmark in a solid ink block at far left, a flat accent-coloured tab holding three text links that runs from the block to 42% of the width, and the single action as a text link at the far right. Below the band, on the paper ground: a standfirst of one sentence at 20px on the 16px left margin, max 30ch, and, starting exactly at 42% of the width, the title on two lines at clamp(64px, 7vw, 96px), medium weight, tracking -0.06em, leading 0.9, running to the right margin. The title's first baseline sits about 110px under the band.
mobile: The band becomes a mosaic of 3 columns and 2 rows taking the top 38% of the screen: two photographs and four colour tiles. The header is a single row above it with the wordmark block and a menu word. The axis collapses to the 16px left margin: the title at 13vw on two lines, then the standfirst at 17px beneath it. The action sits as a text link at the foot of the screen.
headline: The title of the report, programme or product, 2-5 words, at most 26 characters across two lines.

name: Menu column, sticky photograph
blueprint: The viewport is two panels of equal width with a 12px gap between them and 12px outer margins, both with a 20px radius. Right panel: one photograph of the place filling it edge to edge (object-fit: cover), set to position: sticky; top: 12px; height: calc(100svh - 24px), so it stays put while the left side scrolls. A solid bar in the paper colour, 56px tall, lies across the photograph's bottom edge inside the panel and carries opening hours on the left and the address on the right at 15px. Left panel: a filled paper-colour sheet set like a menu card, everything centred. Its top row holds the wordmark, about 300px wide, in the centre with one text link either side. Below, at 34% of the height, the headline in a light serif at clamp(40px, 3.6vw, 56px) on two lines in the accent ink, max 18ch per line. Under it one sentence at 17px, max 40ch, then the single action as a solid rectangle in the accent ink. The lower quarter of the sheet is empty before the first section begins.
mobile: The photograph comes first as a rounded panel 56svh tall on 12px margins, sticky at the top so the paper sheet slides up over its lower part. The hours bar stays on the photograph's bottom edge. The sheet holds the wordmark centred at 46% of the width, the headline at 9vw on two lines, the sentence and a full-width action.
headline: A warm 3-6 word line in a light serif, at most 34 characters, centred on two lines.

name: Anchored text, specimen half
blueprint: The viewport is split exactly in half by two flat tones that meet at a clean vertical edge: the ground on the left, a palette colour on the right. Left half: the wordmark sits top-left on a 40px margin; the next two thirds of the height are empty; everything else is anchored bottom-left and ends 40px above the bottom edge: a headline on one or two lines at clamp(28px, 2.6vw, 40px), medium weight; one sentence at 18px in the soft ink, max 38ch; the single action as a solid rectangle. Right half: position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100svh. In its centre sits a square tile in a second palette colour, 450px wide (31vw) with a 24px radius, holding one cut-out item at 70% of the tile, object-fit: contain, mix-blend-mode: multiply on light fills. Under the tile's left corner the item's name and one fact sit at 15px. As the left column scrolls through the catalogue, the tile's item and colour swap to match the entry in view. One text link sits top-right on the colour field.
mobile: The colour half comes first as a block 52svh tall holding the square tile at 62vw, centred, and stays sticky while the text slides over its lower edge. The text block follows on the ground: the headline at 7vw on two lines, the sentence at 16px, the action full width. The wordmark and one link sit on the top row over the colour.
headline: A modest 3-6 word line at 28-40px, at most 40 characters; the object, not the type, carries the screen.

name: Stepped title, two photographs
blueprint: A pale neutral ground with 6vw side margins on a 12-column grid. Navigation is three small items on the top edge at 15px: one link hard left, the wordmark centred, the single action hard right. The headline is two words or short phrases on two lines in a thin serif at clamp(72px, 7vw, 96px), leading 1.0, stepping diagonally across the middle third of the screen: the first line starts at column 2 with its baseline at 44% of the height; the second is indented to start at column 6 and ends near column 12. Two photographs are placed against the step, both with square corners. A small 16:10 landscape in columns 10-12 hangs from 10% of the height and stops about 20px above the first line. A 4:5 photograph in columns 2-5 starts 24px under the first line's baseline, to the left of the indented second line, and is cropped by the bottom edge of the viewport. Under the second line, starting on column 6, one sentence at 20px in the soft ink, max 36ch. Columns 6-12 of the lower third stay empty.
mobile: The step survives: the first line at 15vw flush to the 20px left margin, the second line indented by 22vw. The small landscape sits above the title at 46% of the width, pushed to the right margin. The tall photograph follows the title at 72% of the width on the left margin, cropped by the bottom of the screen; the sentence at 16px moves beneath it.
headline: Two words or short phrases, one per line, at most 9 characters each so the indented second line fits a phone.

name: Three prints, one line
blueprint: Photographs lead and the type stays small. A pale ground, a 12-column grid, 5vw side margins. The top row at 15px holds the wordmark left, three text links centred and the single action right. Three photographs with square corners hang from one shared top line at 18% of the viewport height, like prints pinned along a rail, each a different size so their bottom edges fall at three heights. A small 1:1 in columns 1-2 (about 190px). A tall 3:4 in columns 4-7, about 440px wide and 590px tall, the largest thing on screen. A 16:10 landscape in columns 9-12 that continues past the right margin and is cropped by the viewport edge. Columns 3 and 8 are left empty as breathing space. The headline sits under the small photograph, left-aligned to its left edge across columns 1-3: a light serif or slender sans at clamp(30px, 2.8vw, 44px) on two lines, followed by one sentence at 16px in the soft ink, max 30ch. One line of caption at 14px sits under the left corner of each of the other two photographs.
mobile: The rail turns vertical, so left edges vary instead of bottoms. The tall photograph comes first at 72% of the width on the left margin; the small square follows at 38% of the width, pushed to the right margin and overlapping the first by 40px; the landscape runs full bleed below. The headline at 8vw sits beside the square on the left, with the sentence at 16px under it.
headline: A quiet 3-6 word line at about 40px, at most 36 characters across two lines.

name: Two prints in darkness
blueprint: One near-black field with a slight colour tint, about 75% of it left empty. Navigation is split between the top corners at 15px on 30px margins: the wordmark and three text links top-left, the single action top-right as the page's one solid light rectangle. Two low-key photographs sit in the dark like lit exhibits, both with square corners and no frame. The larger, a 4:5 portrait about 34% of the viewport wide (columns 6-9), has its top at 14% of the height, so it sits a little above the midline. The smaller, a 1:1 about 12% of the viewport wide (columns 2-3), sits far from it with its top at 52% of the height, dimmed with filter: brightness(0.7) so the large one stays the brightest thing on screen. The headline is modest: two lines at clamp(28px, 2.5vw, 40px) in a regular weight, flush to the bottom-left corner on the 30px margin. Columns 10-12 hold one sentence at 16px in the dimmer ink, bottom-aligned to the headline's last baseline, max 24ch. Nothing else is on screen.
mobile: The large photograph takes 78% of the width, pushed to the right margin, its top at 12% of the height. The small square sits at 30% of the width on the left margin, overlapping the large one's lower-left corner by 24px. The headline sets at 6.4vw on two lines bottom-left with the sentence beneath at 15px. The action is a small solid rectangle top-right; links fold behind a menu word.
headline: A quiet statement of 4-7 words at 28-40px, at most 44 characters on two lines.

name: Void, then statement on axis
blueprint: A deliberate void: the upper 60% of the viewport holds nothing but the top row. That row, 44px from the top on 48px margins, has the wordmark at the left margin, two text links starting exactly on a vertical axis at 42% of the width, and the single action at the right margin as a text link. Everything else hangs from the same axis in the bottom third. The statement starts on the 42% line: two lines at clamp(56px, 6.6vw, 96px), regular or medium weight, tracking -0.04em, leading 0.95, running towards the right margin, with its last baseline 72px above the bottom edge. Left of the axis, in columns 1-4, one supporting sentence at 18px in the soft ink, max 32ch, is bottom-aligned to the statement's last baseline. Nothing sits in the left zone above it. No image and no shape; the ground is one flat tone and the ink one colour. The emptiness is composed: three elements share the axis, so the blank area reads as intended and not as a page that failed to load.
mobile: The axis collapses to the 20px left margin. The top 48% of the screen stays empty under the wordmark row. The statement sets at 12.5vw on two lines, flush left, followed by the sentence at 17px and the action as a text link, the whole block ending 28px above the bottom edge. The two links fold behind a menu word.
headline: A 3-6 word statement, at most 30 characters over two lines, about 15 per line at 6.6vw from the axis.

name: Colour field, two-ink statement
blueprint: One saturated flat colour covers the whole viewport; there is no navigation bar and no image. Two short pieces of 15px text sit in the top corners on 3% margins: the wordmark at the left, the single action as a text link in the dark ink at the right. The statement starts 15% down, left-aligned from the 3% margin, in a soft heavy serif or a heavy grotesk at clamp(96px, 7vw, 96px), tracking -0.03em, leaded so tightly (0.82) that the two lines nearly touch. Line one is set in a pale ink and line two in a dark ink, the only two inks on the field; the pair fills the top 55% of the screen and the longer line reaches about 90% of the width. A long name may be broken across the two lines with a hyphen if the second half reads as a word of its own. In the bottom-right corner, right-aligned in a column 24% of the viewport wide, one supporting sentence at 17px in the pale ink. The bottom-left quarter stays empty colour.
mobile: The same field. The corner texts stay at the top at 14px. The statement sets at 21vw on two lines from a 16px margin, starting at 16% of the height, pale line over dark line. The supporting sentence moves to the bottom-left at 16px across 80% of the width, ending 24px above the bottom edge. The middle fifth of the screen stays empty colour.
headline: The name or a two-word statement over two lines, at most 8 characters per line at 21vw on a phone.

name: One word, cropped
blueprint: A single word is the whole composition, set so large that the viewport crops it. No image. The word is one line in a heavy condensed or heavy grotesk face at clamp(96px, 7vw, 96px), line-height 0.8, white-space: nowrap, placed so its capitals fill the lower half of the screen: the baseline sits 6% below the bottom edge so the feet of the letters are cut, and the line is shifted 8vw to the left so the first letter is cut by the left edge and the last runs off the right (overflow: hidden on the section). Raise the size until both end letters are cut; three to five letters stay fully visible and the word still reads. The top 30% holds everything else on 28px margins: the wordmark at 16px top-left, three text links top-right, and, starting 96px down on the left margin, one supporting sentence at clamp(20px, 1.7vw, 26px), max 34ch, with the single action directly beneath it as a solid rectangle. Ground and ink are two flat values; the word may take the palette's one accent instead of the ink.
mobile: The word turns a quarter turn (writing-mode: vertical-rl) and runs down the right side at 62vw, a fifth of its height cut by the right edge and its ends cut by the top and bottom. The left 45% of the screen holds the wordmark, the sentence at 17px and the action, stacked from the top on a 20px margin. Links fold behind a menu word.
headline: One word of 4-8 letters, the name or the single noun the subject owns; it is cropped but must stay readable.

name: Window that opens to the edges
blueprint: A flat paper or pale ground, and one picture seen through a small window that becomes the whole screen as the page scrolls. The hero is a wrapper 200svh tall holding a stage with `position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100svh`. On the first frame the window is a 4:5 portrait opening 36% of the viewport wide (518×648px), centred, its top and bottom 126px from the edges, square corners; give it a shape from the subject if it has one (an arch, a rounded diamond, a lens). Build it as `clip-path: inset(126px 461px)` on a layer that is itself 100vw by 100svh, so the photograph or muted film inside is laid out full-bleed and never moves: only the opening grows. The headline sits left of the window on columns 1–3: two lines at clamp(44px, 4.4vw, 64px), leading 0.95, flush to the 32px margin, its last baseline level with the window's lower edge. Right of the window on columns 10–12, bottom-aligned to the same line: one supporting sentence at 18px, max 26ch, and the single action as a solid rectangular button. Wordmark top-left and three text links top-right at 15px on the same margin; nothing else sits on the ground. Over the first 100svh of scroll the inset runs to zero on a scroll-linked timeline while the text, which sits above the picture layer, rises and fades out before the opening reaches it; the picture then holds full-bleed for 50svh before the next section slides over it. Without scroll timelines, or under reduced motion, show the open picture with the headline over a neutral scrim in its bottom-left corner.
mobile: The stage stays sticky. The window starts 78vw wide at 4:5, centred, its top at 30% of the height, leaving about a quarter of the screen below it. The headline sits above it at 10vw on two lines inside 20px margins, 72px down; the supporting sentence at 16px and a full-width action sit under the window. The opening reaches the edges within 70svh of scroll. The links fold behind a menu word.
headline: Two short lines of up to about 9 characters each: the name with what it is, or a 2–4 word claim. It scrolls away as the picture takes the screen.

name: Ring of frames around the headline
blueprint: One near-black or deep flat field. Eighteen to twenty-four photographs or film stills sit on an ellipse centred on the viewport, with radii of 560px across and 310px down, so their centres run from x 160 to 1280 and from y 140 to 760. Frames have square corners and no border, mix 4:3 and 3:4, and grow towards the viewer: about 100px wide at the top of the ring and 150px at the bottom and at both ends, so the ring reads as tilted. Each frame is turned so its base lies along the curve (never more than 30 degrees), and neighbours may overlap by up to a fifth. Inside the ring an empty core about 600×340px holds the text, centred: the headline on two lines at clamp(56px, 5.4vw, 80px), leading 0.95, in the light ink; one supporting sentence at 18px, max 40ch, 24px under it; then the single action as a solid light rectangle. Wordmark top-left and three text links top-right at 15px on 32px margins, outside the ring. Every frame is a link to its project: pointing at one, or focusing it, brings it to full brightness, drops the others to 45% and replaces the supporting sentence with that project's name and year. Place the frames with a few lines of trigonometry (left and top in percentages) and keep them still; the wheel scrolls the page as usual.
mobile: The ellipse becomes a circle 132vw across, centred at half height, so the frames at its left and right ends run off both edges and the ring reads as two arcs, one above and one below the text. Keep twelve frames at 64–88px. The headline sits in the core at 10.5vw on two lines inside 28px margins, with the sentence at 16px and the action at the full width of the core beneath it. Wordmark top-left and a menu word top-right sit above the top arc. A tap on a frame opens its project.
headline: A 3–6 word line on two lines, at most about 14 characters per line, so it fits the empty core.

name: Name across the middle
blueprint: Paper and ink only; no picture on the first screen. The name runs on one line across the vertical centre, sized to span from the 18px left margin to the 18px right margin (97.5% of the width). Set it as inline SVG text with a `viewBox` fitted to the word and `width: 100%`, or tune its vw size to the letter count, so it never wraps. In a heavy grotesk the letters stand about 280px tall, from about 310px to 590px; nothing touches or overlaps them. The four corners carry everything else on 18px margins. Top-left: one supporting sentence at 18px on two lines, max 36ch, and 16px below it the single action as a solid ink rectangle. Top-right: a menu word or three text links at 15px. Bottom-left, on a baseline 24px above the edge: the city or the kind of work at 16px. Bottom-right on the same baseline: two or three text links at 15px. The ground between the corners and the name, about 230px above and below it, stays empty and is closed on both sides by the corner texts. The name returns in the footer at the same width with ground and ink swapped and a two-line invitation above it, so the page closes like a bracket.
mobile: The name stays on one line across the width inside 16px margins and moves up to 22% of the height. The supporting sentence follows on the left margin at 17px, then the action at full width. The lower half holds the first picture of the work as a 4:5 frame cropped by the bottom edge, so the screen does not end in empty paper. A menu word sits top-right.
headline: The name itself on one line, up to about 12 characters; the 18px sentence in the top-left corner says what it is.

name: Square over a moving line
blueprint: A white or pale flat ground. One line of display type at clamp(96px, 7vw, 96px), weight 500, tracking -0.02em, runs edge to edge with its cap band centred 360px from the top, moving left at a slow, constant 40px a second: the name, or a claim of two or three words, repeated with a solid round dot one third of the cap height between copies and duplicated for a seamless loop. One square photograph 272px across (19vw), square corners, `object-fit: cover`, sits exactly on the band's centre behind the type, so the words slide across it; the moving line is set twice, the second copy in the paper colour and clipped to the square with `clip-path`, so the letters turn light as they cross the photograph and every word reads whole. It shows the subject's best detail. In the study the photograph sits on top of the words; here nothing lies on top of a headline. 150px under the photograph, centred: one supporting sentence at 22px on two lines, max 36ch, and 24px below it the key fact (a price, a date, an address) at 17px. Top row on 32px margins: one text link on the left, the wordmark centred, one text link on the right. Bottom row on the same margins, 40px above the edge: a location line at 16px on the left and the single action as a solid rectangle on the right. The `h1` holds the moving words once as plain text and the moving copies are `aria-hidden`. Under reduced motion the line stops with one copy centred and both ends cropped.
mobile: The line drops to 34vw with its band at 26% of the height and keeps moving; the photograph shrinks to a 46vw square and stays centred on it. The sentence sits centred at 18px about 64px below the photograph, then the fact at 16px. The action becomes a full-width button 20px above the bottom edge. The wordmark stays centred at the top and the two links fold into a menu word on the right.
headline: The name or a 2–3 word claim of at most 14 characters, set once in the `h1` and repeated in the moving line.

name: Two doors on a dark wall
blueprint: For a subject with two halves a visitor must choose between: two exhibitions, two audiences, two places, two collections. One near-black flat field. Two portrait photographs at 3:4, each 280×373px, stand side by side 80px apart, so the pair spans x 400–1040 (44% of the width) with their tops at 96px; square corners, no frame, the pictures supplying every colour on the screen. Each photograph is the link to its half, and directly beneath it, left-aligned to the frame, sit its name at 22px in the light ink and one line at 16px in the soft ink. The headline is centred above the pair: two lines at clamp(36px, 3.4vw, 52px), leading 1.05, its first line 104px from the top, at most 26 characters per line. Wordmark top-left and one text link top-right at 15px on 32px margins. About 150px of dark ground stays below the pair and 400px either side of it, closed by the two doors at the centre. Pointing at or focusing one door keeps it at full strength and dims the other to 50%. The page continues below with the two halves in order, so each door is also an anchor to its half.
mobile: The pair stays side by side: each photograph 168px wide at 3:4 with a 14px gap, centred at 46% of the height, its name at 17px and its line at 16px beneath it. The headline sits above at 8vw on two lines, centred, 64px down. The wordmark and the link stay in the top corners.
headline: A 4–8 word sentence on two lines that names the choice, at most 26 characters per line.

name: Title from the top edge to the bottom edge
blueprint: One full-bleed photograph or film at 100vw by 100svh, with a horizon near half height and empty sky or darkness above. The headline is two lines in a heavy face at clamp(96px, 7vw, 96px), leading 0.85, pulled as far apart as the screen allows: line one flush to the 32px left margin with its cap line 72px from the top; line two indented 28vw (403px) and anchored to the bottom, its baseline 24px above the lower edge, running towards the right margin. Lay the hero out as a grid of three rows (`grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto`): line one in the first row, line two in the third, both spans of one `h1` with `display: contents`. The middle row leaves the picture clear apart from one supporting sentence at 18px, max 44ch, crossing the horizon at 48% of the height from 30vw, and the single action directly beneath it as a solid rectangular button with its label at 18px. The wordmark and two text links sit top-right on the 32px margin at 15px; the top-left belongs to line one. Choose a picture whose upper-left and lower-right are calm enough for the type, or lay a neutral scrim under those two corners only.
mobile: Keep the two lines at 19vw: line one flush left on a 16px margin 88px down, line two right-aligned to the 16px margin with its baseline 20px above the bottom. The sentence at 17px and the action button sit between them on the left margin, at 46% of the height. The picture is re-cropped to portrait around the horizon.
headline: Two words or short phrases, one per line, at most about 8 characters each.

name: Line-up on an arc
blueprint: For a range: flavours, colourways, editions, sizes. One deep flat ground, which may take the current item's own colour. The current item, a cut-out photograph, stands at the exact centre about 240px wide and 450px tall (y 210–660), tilted no more than 8 degrees. Its siblings stand behind it on a shallow arc, alternately a little higher and lower: each step out is 30% smaller, a quarter darker (`filter: brightness()`) and about 260px further from the centre, three on each side, so the outermost pair is cut by the left and right edges. Under the current item, centred: its name at clamp(32px, 2.8vw, 44px) and one fact at 17px (what it tastes of, what it is made of, the price). The headline sits top-left on columns 1–4 at clamp(36px, 3.2vw, 48px) on two lines with the supporting sentence at 17px under it; the single action, a solid rectangle, sits top-right on a 32px margin. The arc is a horizontal scroller with `scroll-snap-type: x mandatory`, each item snapping to the centre, its scale and brightness set from its distance to the centre, so a drag, a swipe, the arrow keys or a click on a sibling brings it forward; the ground colour follows with a 300ms transition. No arrows drawn on the screen and no counter.
mobile: The current item takes 55% of the width and half the height, centred at 46% of the height; one sibling peeks in at each edge at 60% scale, half cut off. The headline sits at the top at 8vw on two lines with the supporting sentence beneath; the item's name and fact sit under the item at 24px and 16px. The action becomes a full-width button 20px above the bottom edge.
headline: A plain 3–6 word line on two lines, at most 20 characters per line; the item's own name under the object changes with the selection.
